create.name: Amanda Giacomini
create.bio:
Amanda Giacomini is a yoga teacher and painter, known as an artist by the name of her project, 10,000 Buddhas. She has practised yoga for more than thirty years, meditated for longer, and taught for a quarter of a century; in 2001 she co-founded Point Reyes Yoga, a small studio on the coast of Marin County in Northern California, where she leads trainings. Her art began on a visit to the Ajanta caves in India, where an ancient mural of a thousand seated Buddhas moved her to set herself the task of painting ten thousand. She passed that number over about ten years, and her Buddhas now appear on walls in many American cities and abroad, as well as on canvas, paper and fabric.

As a teacher she favours slow, quiet practice, especially yin and restorative yoga, and likes to weave stories from Buddhist and yogic tradition into a class. At Point Reyes Yoga she co-leads, with Kimiko Tao Fujimoto, short in-person trainings in restorative and yin yoga, and she leads occasional retreats abroad, such as a week of yoga, storytelling and walks to holy wells on Ireland's west coast. She has taught at yoga festivals, museums and other public venues around the world.

courses.title: RESOURCE: Restorative Yoga Teacher Training
courses.description: A four-day, 30-hour training at Point Reyes Yoga with Amanda and Kimiko Tao Fujimoto. It covers the history and principles of restorative yoga, sequencing and class design, prop set-ups and cueing, and meditative presence.

courses.title: NOURISH: Yin Yoga Training in Point Reyes
courses.description: The studio's third annual yin yoga training with Amanda and Kimiko: classic yin postures, pranayama, mantra and meditation, and subtle-body ideas such as meridians and koshas, taught partly through story.

courses.title: Ireland Retreat with Amanda & Radha
courses.description: A week on Ireland's west coast with Marisa Radha Weppner at the Cliffs of Moher Retreat Center: daily yoga and meditation, restorative practice with Celtic stories, coastal walks and visits to holy wells.
